item.title: Galliano withdraws from Met exhibition after antisemitism uproar
item.description:
Fashion designer John Galliano has withdrawn from a planned solo exhibition at the Metropolitan Museum of Art following intense backlash. The decision came after donors, politicians and Jewish leaders questioned honoring a designer convicted of an antisemitic hate crime in 2011. The New York Times reported that the Met's director, Max Hollein, confirmed the cancellation Monday.
